parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT $1::uuid AS esc, $2::uuid AS lead, NULLIF(lower($3), '') AS area, NULLIF($4, '') AS resp_txt),
-- usa o responsável indicado pela consulta de horários, se for válido; senão escolhe de novo
r AS (
  SELECT * FROM responsaveis
  WHERE escritorio_id = (SELECT esc FROM p) AND ativo AND faz_reunioes
    AND id::text = COALESCE((SELECT resp_txt FROM p),
                            escolher_responsavel((SELECT esc FROM p), (SELECT lead FROM p), (SELECT area FROM p), false, true)::text)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM responsaveis WHERE id = escolher_responsavel((SELECT esc FROM p), (SELECT lead FROM p), (SELECT area FROM p), false, true)
  LIMIT 1)
SELECT to_jsonb(e) AS escritorio, to_jsonb(r) AS responsavel, to_jsonb(l) AS lead,
       COALESCE(r.google_calendar_id, e.google_calendar_id, '') AS calendar_id
FROM escritorios e JOIN leads l ON l.escritorio_id = e.id AND l.id = (SELECT lead FROM p)
LEFT JOIN r ON true
WHERE e.id = (SELECT esc FROM p);

parameters.query:
-- A constraint "agendamentos_sem_conflito" impede choque de horário mesmo com dois clientes ao mesmo tempo.
INSERT INTO agendamentos (escritorio_id, lead_id, responsavel_id, inicio, fim, modalidade, area, resumo, google_calendar_id)
SELECT $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::timestamptz, $5::timestamptz, $6, NULLIF($7, ''), NULLIF($8, ''), NULLIF($9, '')
WHERE NOT $10::boolean
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

WITH a AS (
  UPDATE agendamentos SET google_event_id = NULLIF($2, ''), link_reuniao = NULLIF($3, ''), atualizado_em = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING *)
UPDATE leads l SET status = 'agendado', responsavel_id = a.responsavel_id,
       nome = COALESCE(NULLIF($4, ''), l.nome), email = COALESCE(NULLIF($5, ''), l.email),
       area = COALESCE(a.area, l.area), resumo_caso = COALESCE(a.resumo, l.resumo_caso), atualizado_em = now()
FROM a WHERE l.id = a.lead_id
RETURNING a.id AS agendamento_id, a.link_reuniao;
